sdsGap.note: No manufacturer-authored SDS/TDS document is identified as an exact source in the 232-entry unreviewed queue. OSHA HazCom SDS guidance is not a manufacturer SDS.
sdsGap.humanAction: Locate first-party product-specific SDS/TDS and independently verify rights, revision, issuer, exact URL, attribution, retention and mirror permission before any acquisition.

humanReviewRequirements: Record exact asset URL, MIME, document revision/effective date and publisher provenance.
Record rights holder, applicable licence/terms or explicit permission and evidence URL.
Separate text/data acquisition rights from image/swatch rights and Drive mirror rights.
Set retention, attribution, expiry/review date and withdrawal procedure.
Do not change source identity/UUID, follow links, infer permissions or grant source-wide rights.
